final_candidates.decision_summary: H41 is a zinc-coordinating histidine in the BRCA1 RING domain. Substitution to arginine disrupts zinc coordination, abolishing E3 ligase activity and BARD1 interaction while the rest of the protein folds normally.
C24 is a zinc-coordinating cysteine in zinc site 1 of the RING domain. Serine substitution removes the thiol required for zinc coordination, disrupting RING structure and function locally.

stop_reason.detail: Top-3 candidates verified against sequence, targeting distinct zinc-coordinating residues across both RING domain zinc sites; further iteration unlikely to improve.
